name: Porchlight
what_it_does: Volunteer matching for Lowcountry nonprofits. Volunteers pick causes and free hours, and Porchlight lists nearby shifts from food banks, river cleanups, and animal shelters with one-click signup. Built in 20 hours on a free Firebase tier.
target_user: Charleston residents who want to volunteer but do not know which nonprofits need help this week.

agent_observations.note: Reviewers love Porchlight (would_use 0.81, easy_to_use 0.79), but the automated checks found 4 console errors and no security headers. No product in the pool lists reliability or security as a capability, so there is no honest match yet.
